TextView.android:text: Women's Safety Tips
Safety Categories
Personal Safety
Share live location with a trusted person when stepping out alone.
Avoid walking in isolated or dark areas, especially at night.
Trust your gut feeling — if it feels unsafe, leave.
Save emergency contacts on speed dial.
Carry safety items (pepper spray, whistle, alarm).
Be cautious while accepting food or drinks from strangers.
Keep your phone charged and carry a power bank.
Always lock doors and windows properly at home.
Learn basic self-defense techniques.
Avoid wearing headphones at night when walking alone.
Inform family/friends when reaching or leaving a place.
Don’t disclose personal details to unknown people quickly.
Be aware of your surroundings at all times.
Keep cash and cards in different places (not all together).
Avoid isolated lifts or staircases with strangers.
Travel Safety
Book rides through trusted apps and verify driver/vehicle details.
Sit in the back seat while traveling alone.
Share trip details with friends/family.
Avoid displaying expensive items (jewelry, gadgets).
Keep ID proofs and documents handy.
Use official taxi stands or ride services at airports/railway stations.
Check hotel room locks and emergency exits before staying.
Don’t accept help with luggage from unknown people.
Keep a backup of your tickets and documents digitally.
Avoid over-sharing your travel plans on social media.
Use GPS navigation to ensure you’re on the right route.
Travel during the daytime whenever possible.
Carry a small first-aid kit and personal medicines.
Keep emergency cash separate from your wallet.
Learn basic local language words (help, police, hospital).
Online Safety
Use strong, unique passwords for each account.
Enable two-factor authentication (2FA).
Avoid clicking on unknown links or attachments.
Don’t share OTPs, bank details, or passwords.
Regularly update apps, browsers, and antivirus.
Limit personal details shared on social media.
Avoid posting your real-time location online.
Block and report abusive/fake accounts.
Verify emails before replying (phishing check).
Don’t download apps outside official app stores.
Use privacy settings to control who sees your posts.
Don’t video call or chat with strangers you don’t trust.
Use VPN when connecting to public Wi-Fi.
Log out from accounts when using shared devices.
Back up important files securely.
